mismatch.owner: do.c:goto_level ordinary stair fall selftouch caller

summary: On the final downward-stair input, the accepted JavaScript replay misses the C screen after Fumbling makes the hero fall while wielding a cockatrice corpse. C do.c:goto_level calls selftouch("Falling, you") after fall damage; js/do.js:goto_level skips that call with note_unported('trap.c selftouch'). The existing js/trap.js:selftouch implementation already ports trap.c:selftouch, so this is missing caller wiring in goto_level. The C call returns no value; the JavaScript gap marker improperly omits an available source call.

source.branch: After downward stair travel, when excessive burden, punishment, or Fumbling causes a stair fall, goto_level applies fall effects and then calls selftouch("Falling, you") before the arrival tail.
callers: dodown() at do.c:1131-1294 calls goto_level() at do.c:1287; js/do.js:dodown() routes through next_level() to goto_level().

evidence: The admitted v96 evaluation records 147/148 screens, 147/148 cursors, and 4892/4892 RNG calls for this recording; the saved comparison localizes the first mismatch to segment 0, step 147, the final '>' input, with no RNG mismatch.

The frozen v96 preparation evidence identifies the planned behavior as a Fumbling downward-stair fall with a gloved wielded cockatrice corpse and records the original comparison against the accepted JavaScript pin. The JS object tree was verified unchanged through the published accepted base.
Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/do.c:1796 calls selftouch("Falling, you") after the stair-fall damage branch; nethack-c/upstream/src/trap.c:3883-3910 implements that helper.

js/do.js:3071-3074 currently substitutes note_unported('trap.c selftouch') at the matching stair-fall call site. js/trap.js:selftouch implements trap.c:selftouch, so this call can be wired without new gameplay behavior or session-specific logic.

A second matching note_unported('trap.c selftouch') exists in the goto_level random-arrival fall branch at js/do.js:3099, paired with upstream do.c:1808. It is the same discarded-result callee and should be wired consistently if within the claimed caller scope.
